claims: New users can get a 7-day Apple TV+ free trial.
Purchasing a new iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple TV device offers 3 months free Apple TV+.
A 1-month Apple TV+ trial is available via Apple One.
Up to 3 months Apple TV+ free trial is available via student plans.
Apple TV+ is typically priced at $12.99/month after the trial ends.
The 7-Day Free Trial is a standard, direct trial for new subscribers.
The 3-Month Free Trial is available upon purchasing an eligible new Apple device.
The 3-Month Free Trial must be activated within 90 days.
The 1-Month Free Trial is included with an Apple One bundle subscription.
The Student Trial includes 1 month free when signing up for an Apple Music student plan.
A valid credit/debit card must be on file.
Apple TV+ trials can be canceled at any time.
Users generally keep access to Apple TV+ until the trial period ends after cancellation.
A 50s YouTube video by The Stream Guide published on Dec 11, 2024 explains how to get a 7-day free trial of Apple TV+.
